keyPoints.en: Causes: loss of rulers' and chiefs' power, new taxes and land rules, disrespect for customs and religion.
keyPoints.bm: Punca: kehilangan kuasa raja dan pembesar, cukai dan peraturan tanah baharu, tidak menghormati adat dan agama.

keyPoints.en: Most resistance failed due to modern weapons and lack of unity, but it inspired later nationalism.
keyPoints.bm: Kebanyakan penentangan gagal kerana senjata moden dan kurang perpaduan, tetapi menjadi inspirasi nasionalisme kemudian.

keyPoints.en: Naning: Dol Said (1831–1832). Perak: Maharaja Lela (1875).
keyPoints.bm: Naning: Dol Said (1831–1832). Perak: Maharaja Lela (1875).

tip.en: Make a table: leader | state | year | cause. It covers most questions.
tip.bm: Buat jadual: pemimpin | negeri | tahun | punca. Ia meliputi kebanyakan soalan.

keyPoints.en: Sarawak: Rentap (Iban, Bukit Sadok), Sharif Masahor — against Brooke rule.
keyPoints.bm: Sarawak: Rentap (Iban, Bukit Sadok), Sharif Masahor — menentang pemerintahan Brooke.

keyPoints.en: Sabah: Mat Salleh (1894–1900), Antanom (Rundum, 1915) — against company taxes and forced labour.
keyPoints.bm: Sabah: Mat Salleh (1894–1900), Antanom (Rundum, 1915) — menentang cukai syarikat dan kerahan tenaga.
